pluginDocs.title: Build a Plugin
pluginDocs.intro: A jano plugin is a single TypeScript file that exports a LanguagePlugin object. No build system required - esbuild bundles it for you.

optionalHooks.highlight: Regex-based syntax highlighting - define patterns for comments, strings, keywords etc.
optionalHooks.highlightLine: Full custom highlighting - return tokens per line, with access to all lines (for multiline strings, block comments etc.)
optionalHooks.onKeyDown: Intercept any key press before the editor handles it. Return handled: true to prevent default behavior. Great for auto-close brackets, snippets, custom shortcuts.
optionalHooks.onCursorAction: Fires after each edit (char typed, newline, backspace, delete, tab, paste). Use for auto-indent, auto-close, list continuation etc.
optionalHooks.onFormat: Fires on F3. Reformat the entire document.
optionalHooks.onSave: Fires on Ctrl+S. Apply edits before saving.
optionalHooks.onOpen: Fires when a file is opened.
optionalHooks.onValidate: Validate the document content. Return diagnostics (errors, warnings) shown inline. Debounced and called in the background while the user types.
optionalHooks.onComplete: Provide autocomplete suggestions. Fires on Ctrl+Space or automatically after typing (300ms debounce). Return completions for the current cursor position.

tipsList: All hooks are optional - start with just highlight and add more as needed
onKeyDown gets the full key info (name, ctrl, alt, shift) and can prevent default editor behavior
onCursorAction receives deletedText for backspace/delete - useful for auto-close bracket pairs
highlightLine overrides regex-based highlight when both are defined
Use replaceAll in EditResult to replace the entire document (e.g. for formatting)
onComplete items can include a 'kind' (keyword, function, variable, property, type, constant, snippet) - jano shows an icon for each
Plugin crashes never break the editor - jano runs all hooks through an isolating wrapper
The plugin never sees editor internals - it only works with lines, cursors, and edits

items.title: Your fingers already know it.
items.text: Save, undo, find, copy, paste. Every shortcut works like everywhere else, and so does the mouse.

items.title: Multi-cursor.
items.text: Select the next match, type once, change them all. Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down adds cursors line by line.

items.title: Format and diagnostics.
items.text: Plugins format your file and point at errors right in the line.

items.title: Nothing gets lost.
items.text: jano keeps a backup while you type. If it gets killed, the next start offers to bring your text back.

items.title: Project settings.
items.text: jano reads .editorconfig. Tabs in the Makefile, two spaces in the YAML, without touching your own settings.

items.title: Undo history.
items.text: Browse every change of the session and jump back to any point.

items.title: Help is one key away.
items.text: Every shortcut, in the editor, always.
